# bike-glossary

- **groupset** — see [[bike-groupset]] for the full explanation
- **cassette** — the cluster of sprockets on the rear wheel
- **derailleur** — the mechanism that moves the chain between sprockets or chainrings
- **dish** — how centered a wheel's rim sits relative to the frame's centerline; a wheel can be
  perfectly round and still be "out of dish"
- **true** (as a verb) — adjusting spoke tension so the wheel spins without wobbling side to side
